evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the HTTP server and bitcoin-cli to add UNIX domain socket support.
rationale: Adds UNIX domain socket support to the HTTP server and bitcoin-cli, addressing a long-standing feature request dating back to 2014 (#5029). Operating local RPC via UNIX sockets eliminates loopback networking overhead and removes the need for -rpcallowip by relying on standard filesystem permissions for access control.
